values: Which plot best shows general HOMER performance against the baseline?
It shows the tuned anchor spatial baseline against the validation-selected HOMER config and older HOMER references.
Does an anchor-only spatial prior explain anchor-CV?
Mostly yes: tuned mouse+human kernel reaches 76.2% top-1 vs HOMER selected 81.0%.
Does the anchor-only spatial baseline preserve brain-wide FC as well as HOMER?
No: tuned anchor spatial r=0.242 and within-network r=0.066 vs HOMER selected r=0.368 and within-network r=0.439.
Bandwidth tuning selected on same benchmark
The tuned anchor-only result is optimistic unless bandwidth is fixed or tuned in a nested validation scheme.
